title: ai-net-protect-rp-2022
summary: A largely boilerplate GitLab project template repository containing a data-synthesis exploration notebook under a 'datasynthesizer' folder. The notebook imports the sdv package and calls sdv.demo.load_timeseries_demo() to pull in a built-in synthetic time-series demo dataset.
needs: Only a demo dataset loader call is visible; no evidence of an actual synthesizer being trained or used, and README gives no real project description.
